This vertical editorial illustration features a person seen from behind against a plain white background. The person has short, dark, voluminous hair and wears a dark, possibly navy or black, long-sleeved garment with a red panel across the upper back and shoulders. Their right arm is raised high, holding a small rectangular red card aloft. Their left arm hangs down at their side, showing a glimpse of a red bracelet. Several gold-colored rings or bangles circle their right wrist.

Above and to the left of the person, bold black and red text is arranged. Transcribed text includes "TEMPO" in large red letters, followed by "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below that, larger black text reads "UNJUK KUASA DI PIALA DUNIA". Smaller text below says "Megawati Soekarnoputri ditengarai berada di balik keputusan dua gubernur PDI Perjuangan penolak timnas Israel yang berujung batalnya Indonesia menjadi tuan rumah Piala Dunia U-20. Jokowi gagal mengantisipasi. H.22". 

At the top, "Kalang Kabut Pakaian Bekas Impor H.74" and "Babak Baru Rekening Gendut Pejabat Keuangan H.64" appear. The bottom left contains publication details: "3-9 APRIL 2023", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode.
